text: For a thousand years, the Mantis Warriors guarded a cluster of worlds at the edge of the Maelstrom, alone.
Then Lufgt Huron, the Tyrant of Badab, called on his brothers to defend their freedom from Terra.
They never knew Huron had already given his soul to Chaos.
When the war was lost, they begged the Emperor's forgiveness, and it was granted.
But their Chapter Master was stripped of his armour, and locked away for life.
Their home was given away, and they were sent on a hundred-year crusade, forbidden to recruit.
Year after year, their numbers dwindled.
They were forgiven. But many still call them traitors.
